objectClass.primaryType: fantasy leaf-blade sword (PS1-era low-poly game asset render)
objectClass.notes: Double-edged leaf blade with an embedded violet core and frontal magenta spine; radial 6-rod emitter fan at the guard; faceted black grip. Everything planar-faceted flat-shaded — absence of microtexture/decals is part of the identity.

reasoning: Three macro assemblies (blade / guard / handle) with brief-mandated 47-node decomposition.
One repetition system: 2x3 crimson emitter rods (5 visible, 1 occluded/inferred).
Seven distinct material zones incl. a translucent shell over an opaque gradient core — transparency ordering is the main technical risk.
Flat-shaded facets, zero microtexture: local detail density is low but facet-band shading is identity-defining.
Occlusion: back face, blade tip (cropped), grip lower half + pommel (cropped), rod roots behind shoulders.

specDepthDecision.rationale: complex: many named parts, one repetition system, seven material zones, three hierarchy levels, and an action contract (explode + per-part isolate) demanded by the brief.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: 2-3 vertical lavender-grey value bands along the shell's left edge — per-facet flat shading steps, not a smooth ramp
violet core reads as two planes: darker front plane and lighter right bevel plane, split along the blade axis
bright violet rim accent along the core's lower-right bevel edge
core lower end splits into two legs forming an inverted-V notch; apex ~(72,172)px, legs end y~205-212
central spine: dark burgundy upper spike, bright red-magenta lower diamond, hard colour boundary
spine overlaps the core's notch edges — it sits in front (+Z) of the core with a small clearance
crimson rod bodies with near-black top faces and darker end caps — two-tone facet lacquer
3 visible left rods project down-left, 2 visible right rods project up-right; radiation centre below the hub on the blade axis; possible 3rd right rod occluded by shoulder
gunmetal shoulders are folded angular plates with a visible facet value split, angled outward-downward
khaki-gold lit face + dark olive shadow face wedge at each shoulder tip; right block larger, cone-like fold
central hub is an olive-gold faceted arrowhead/collar under the blade base with dark inner facets; spine's lower diamond partially occluded by it
black grip rod shows a lit dark-grey front-left plane and a near-black side plane — low-sided faceted profile
soft darker band on the shell along the core's right edge — internal depth/contact shadow
shell narrows into the hub; white corner wedges visible left and right of the guard cluster
tip cropped by frame; shell still wide at top edge, so a substantial pointed tip length is inferred

definitionOfDone: Reference-matched view (camera solved for the measured ~18 deg axis tilt) reaches silhouette IoU >= 0.90 with both leaf edges within ~3 px reprojected error.
Violet core stays clearly readable through the milky shell in front, back, and three-quarter views, keeping its two-plane gradient banding and bright rim.
Inverted-V notch + two-tone magenta spine read correctly at thumbnail scale.
Emitter fan: 5 visible rods within ~4 deg of measured projected angles; 6th rod placed per mirror policy, confidence 0.45, marked inferred.
47 named nodes with sockets, setExplode/resetAssembly/setPartVisible runtime; explode sweep returns bit-stable to assembled.
PS1 facet language: flat shading on identity facets, no smoothing, no added decals/engravings; tone mapping preserves violet saturation and the 7 distinct material zones.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Leaf-blade silhouette matches the measured axis tilt and edge profiles; blade:guard:handle proportions match reference pixel measurements; cropped tip/pommel follow the brief's inference policy.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object
major proportions are guessed without evidence

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: All 47 brief-mandated nodes exist under bladeAssembly/guardAssembly/handleAssembly; shell, core, and spine are separate volumes; rods are individual nodes.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh
component hierarchy is too shallow for the observed complexity

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Core embedded inside shell; spine offset +Z in the notch with clearance; rods rooted at the measured radiation centre; shoulders flush with hub; olive blocks capped on shoulder tips; handle butts the hub along -Y.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent
branch/limb/tube is centered in space instead of pivoting from its root
parent-child transform mixes world and local coordinates

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Seven material zones with per-facet flat shading; shell translucent milky (not clear glass) with internal depth shadow; core gradient banded per facet; rods two-tone lacquer; metals restrained aged tones.
failureModes: surface looks like flat plastic
local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Lighting reproduces the reference's soft directional read without killing facet bands; tone mapping keeps violet saturation; core visible through shell in all review views; no baked-in photographic lighting exists to remove (flat-shaded source).
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic
colors are a generic average instead of reference-observed local color zones
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

featureGroups.name: Core readable through translucent shell
qualityCriteria: Purple core clearly visible through the outer shell from front/back/three-quarter; shell neither fully invisible nor clear glass; stable transparency ordering (renderOrder/depthWrite deliberate).
failureModes: core invisible or muddy behind shell
shell disappears entirely
transparency sorting popping between views

featureGroups.name: Emitter rod fan layout
qualityCriteria: Rod axes reproduce measured projected angles from a common radiation centre below the hub; 3+3 contract with hidden rod(s) marked inferred at 0.45.
failureModes: rods parallel instead of radial
fan mirrored naively left/right against evidence
rods fused to guard as one mesh

featureGroups.name: PS1 facet shading language
qualityCriteria: Flat shading with visible facet value steps on shell/core/rods; low-segment profiles (8-side grip); no smooth normals on identity facets, no decals/engravings/screws.
failureModes: smooth-shaded modern look
over-detailed ornamentation the reference does not support

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
